hs2-031.title: Your role in a real drill
hs2-031.lead: The drill you just ran is the same for everyone. In real life, your first moves differ by role.

items.title: Patients first
items.body_html: Rescue the patients in your area, then use the evacuation tool made for stairs. Proposed — SME to confirm.

items.title: Visitors and arrivals
items.body_html: Stop arrivals, guide visitors to the assembly point and bring the day's list. Proposed — SME to confirm.

items.title: Routes and utilities
items.body_html: Keep routes clear and isolate utilities only when told. Proposed — SME to confirm.
